en-US.title: Pixely: Relaxing Pixel Art
en-US.short_description: Relaxing pixel art color by number game. Paint offline to relieve stress!
en-US.full_description:
Welcome to Pixely: Relaxing Pixel Art – the ultimate pixel coloring book designed to help you unwind, destress, and unleash your inner artist. Dive into a calming world of color by number games that you can play anywhere, anytime, and completely offline!

Looking for a peaceful escape from daily stress? Pixely makes pixel coloring simple, satisfying, and frustration-free. Just tap the numbers, fill in the colors, and watch beautiful 8-bit retro drawings come to life.

---

🎨 WHY YOU'LL LOVE PIXELY

We designed our pixel art coloring book to be the perfect companion for relaxation and mental wellness.
• 100% Offline Mode: Paint by number anywhere you go—no internet connection or Wi-Fi needed! Perfect for flights, commutes, and travel.
• Easy & Intuitive: No complex palettes or rules. Simply select a color, tap to color by number, and zoom in to catch every detail.
• Endless Variety: Hundreds of stunning pixel art templates, ranging from cute animals, beautiful flowers, fantasy creatures, to retro 8-bit patterns.
• Stress Relief & Calming: A quiet, satisfying sensory experience. Research shows coloring by numbers helps reduce anxiety and improve focus.

✨ AWESOME FEATURES

• Magic Brushes: Use the long-press and slide gesture to paint adjacent pixels quickly.
• Retro 8-Bit Vibes: Enjoy nostalgic, clean graphics with a gorgeous, modern, user-friendly interface.
• Suitable for All Ages: Perfect for kids, adults, and seniors alike. Fun for the whole family!
• Regular Updates: Fresh coloring pages added regularly to keep your coloring journey exciting.

🧠 HEALTH BENEFITS OF COLOR BY NUMBER

Pixely is more than just a pixel art game—it is an early-development tool and stress-relief sanctuary:
• Mindfulness & Focus: Promotes deep concentration and a calm state of mind.
• Hand-Eye Coordination: Strengthens fine motor skills through precise pixel tapping.
• Creative Expression: Experiment with vibrant colors in a relaxing digital sandbox.

Download Pixely: Relaxing Pixel Art today!
Relieve anxiety, color away your stress, and discover the joy of offline coloring games. Your next pixel masterpiece is just a tap away!
en-US.whats_new: Initial release of Pixely! Relieve stress and color offline with hundreds of vibrant pixel art templates, magic brushes, and satisfying time-lapse replays.
